common_gotchas: Callback Mode changes callback argument shape, so generated callback templates must match either ParGroup objects or lists.
Parameter groups are tuple-style groups, not just individual scalar Par values.
Value-change callbacks can fire every frame for changing parameters; batch/list mode is safer for high-frequency changes.
As with Parameter Execute DAT, callbacks that write back to watched parameters need reentry guards.
key_concepts: Runs callbacks for parameter groups rather than individual parameter tuples.
Callback Mode controls how parameter group changes are reported to the script.
Monitored callbacks include value, pulse, expression, export, enable, and mode changes.
Custom and built-in toggles constrain which parameter groups are watched.
